question: If the mean proportional of X and 147 is 84, then find the value of X.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The square of the mean proportional is equal to the product of the two numbers.

84² = X × 147

X = (84 × 84) ÷ 147

X = 7056 ÷ 147 = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number = X

Second number = 147

Mean proportional = 84

**Formula Used:**

Mean Proportional = √(First number × Second number)
